title: Core Duo #43
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio, two women in a single row.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 2 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her mid 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, fair skin, bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart stickers on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips, a bright, giddy grin, bold and confident, warm honey-blonde hair styled in long thick box braids, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, matte finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Moroccan zellige tile mosaic — a deep cobalt ground with interlocking white, terracotta and gold motifs, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense interlocking star-and-cross motifs filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward.

Left woman's footwear: extreme gold plain stiletto pumps, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and lime paint strokes across the cheekbones, rhinestone and star stickers clustered on the cheeks and forehead only, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, a fierce, playful expression, bold and confident, pure icy-white hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real living eyes. Long almond nails, glittery finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Italian Deruta majolica — a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre-yellow floral medallions, wide cobalt-and-ochre bands following every deep crease, dense repeating floral border filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: back fully to camera.

Right woman's footwear: extreme cobalt-and-ochre ballet heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 2, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 landscape 8K.
